text:
I went to this salon because of the good reviews, but my experience was very disappointing…

At first, a woman took care of me and completely botched the job: her nails were cut way too short, and she applied the top coat before the polish… clearly a mess. As a result, a second employee had to redo the entire service from scratch.

I spent almost two hours at the salon for what should have been a simple procedure. There was no compensation offered at the end, despite the wait and the mistakes. The second woman apologized, admitting that her colleague had cut my nails much too short.

The only positive point: the pink color is pretty. But that doesn't make up for everything else. You really have to get lucky and find the right person, because they clearly don't all have the same skill level.
